title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartp
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartphone selfie of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, reclining comfortably against large taupe-brown upholstered cushions on a bed or sofa in a softly lit modern interior. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has very fair, smooth skin with soft neutral-to-pink undertones and realistic natural texture, a petite softly tapered oval face, a delicate narrow jawline, a small straight refined nose, softly rounded cheeks with visible rosy blush, and small glossy coral-pink lips held in a subtle pout. Her large almond-shaped eyes appear medium brown to gray-brown under the lighting, emphasized by fine black winged eyeliner, long curled lashes, softly blended pink-beige eyeshadow, and neatly shaped dark brows. She looks slightly off-camera with a calm, cute, mildly playful expression.

Her hair is a short dark chestnut-brown bob, smooth and glossy, with blunt straight bangs cut evenly across the forehead just above the eyes. Longer face-framing sections curve gently along both cheeks and taper toward the jaw, while the rest of the hair is tucked naturally behind the head.

Frame her from approximately the upper torso upward in a close, slightly high-angle handheld selfie composition. She reclines backward with her shoulders relaxed and torso facing the camera. One hand is raised beside her face, with the index finger gently touching or pointing toward her cheek while the remaining fingers curl naturally inward.

She wears a revealing pale cream floral lingerie-style camisole or bustier top with tiny pink-and-green flower prints, delicate lace edging around the low neckline, thin shoulder straps, and narrow pink ribbon details crossing near the center of the bust. Over it she wears a soft dusty-pink knitted cardigan, loosely draped off the shoulders and arms, with visible ribbed cuffs and textured knit fabric.

Use soft diffused daylight entering from the side, producing bright luminous skin, gentle facial highlights, and minimal harsh shadow. Background elements include oversized brown cushions, a white pillow beneath her shoulder, a pale wall, and a small section of beige textured upholstery. Simulate a modern smartphone main camera around 24–28mm equivalent, close focusing distance, mild perspective distortion, shallow natural depth separation, crisp eyes and eyelashes, realistic skin detail, subtle beauty-camera softness without plastic texture, warm pastel color grading, low contrast, creamy highlights, muted browns, blush pinks, and an intimate social-media selfie aesthetic. 9:16
